title: 성격 1: 어떤 사람이에요? 착하다, 친절하다, 활발하다
objective: By the end, you can describe a friend, a family member, or someone you met with basic personality words, in short sentences like 성격이 밝아요 or 친절한 사람이에요.
summary: Learn nine basic words for talking about what people are like, such as kind, friendly, outgoing, and quiet.

task.title: Describe the people
task.line: Read each short situation about a person, then choose, write, or order the Korean words that describe them.

words.example: 우리 언니는 저와 성격이 많이 달라요.
words.exampleMeaning: My older sister's personality is very different from mine.

words.meaning: good-hearted, kind (a good person who helps others)
words.example: 민수는 착해서 할머니 짐을 들어 드렸어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Minsu is good-hearted, so he carried an old woman's bags for her.

words.meaning: friendly and helpful (to customers, strangers, etc.)
words.exampleMeaning: The staff at that shop were really friendly and helpful.
Sara is outgoing, so she has a lot of friends.

words.meaning: quiet (a person who doesn't talk much)
words.exampleMeaning: My husband is a quiet person.

words.example: 지수 씨는 항상 웃어요. 성격이 밝아요.
words.exampleMeaning: Jisu always smiles. She has a cheerful personality.

words.meaning: fun, funny (a person who is fun to be with)
words.example: 제 친구는 재미있어서 같이 있으면 많이 웃어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My friend is funny, so I laugh a lot when we're together.

words.meaning: hard-working, active (does things early and doesn't waste time)
words.example: 아버지는 부지런하셔서 매일 아침 여섯 시에 일어나세요.
words.exampleMeaning: My father is hard-working, so he gets up at six every morning.

words.example: 주말에는 제가 좀 게을러요. 하루 종일 누워 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm a bit lazy on weekends. I lie around all day.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 길을 물어봤는데 그 아저씨가 지도까지 그려 줬어요. 아저씨가 (친절해요 / 게을러요). ② 우리 형은 말이 적고 혼자 책 읽기를 좋아해요. 형은 (활발해요 / 조용해요). ③ 그 배우는 농담을 자주 해요. 그 배우는 (재미있어요 / 조용해요).
Fill in the blank with 게으르다 in the -아요/어요 form: 제 룸메이트는 설거지를 안 하고 오후까지 자요. 정말 ____.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list (활발하다 / 조용하다 / 게으르다) in its noun-modifying -(으)ㄴ form: 새로 온 친구는 ____ 사람이에요. 모두에게 먼저 말을 걸고 운동도 좋아해요.
Who is 착하다? Choose one: ① 민호: 동생 과자를 몰래 다 먹었어요. ② 유나: 아픈 친구에게 숙제를 가져다줬어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 밝아요 / 제 친구는 / 아주 / 성격이
Fill in the blank with the polite (honorific) form of 부지런하다: 할머니는 매일 일찍 일어나서 산책하세요. 정말 ____.
answers: ① 친절해요 ② 조용해요 ③ 재미있어요
제 친구는 성격이 아주 밝아요. (제 친구는 아주 성격이 밝아요.)
